description: Round 3 of the full-parity phase (expressions family, seeds 9001-9010, 20000 cases): P35, the lines PHP gives the constants it folds inside array literals. Part b (round 3, minimised from x9004-00465-arrays, 4 raw cases): a conditional whose test folds keeps the line of its chosen branch when that branch is already a value (a literal, or a concatenation the parser folded); a branch that zend_eval_const_expr() folds takes the literal's line (controls). Part a (reported by the round-2 fix of P31/P32, reproduced here): the markers of a dynamic key decide the literal's line. Vectors with known_mismatch still differ; the others are controls that must stay identical. Recorded with "isolation": "process".

vectors.note: minimised from x9004-00465-arrays (4 raw cases: x9004-00465-arrays, x9005-00433-arrays, x9007-00933-arrays, x9010-01217-arrays); the chosen branch `("")` is a literal written after the `// line 2` of `r`

known_mismatch.reason: P35 (plans/parity-fixes.md, G1), part b: inside an array literal, zend_eval_const_expr() replaces a conditional whose test folds (`? :`, `?:`, `??`) by its chosen child itself (ZEND_AST_CONDITIONAL, ZEND_AST_COALESCE in PHPSRC/Zend/zend_compile.c), so a child that is already a value (a number or string literal) keeps its own line, while a value zend_eval_const_expr() creates (a negative number, true/false/null, a folded operator) gets the literal's line. The `*` emitted after the operand reports that line (zend_compile_expr_inner() sets CG(zend_lineno)). twig-rs gives every folded conditional the literal's line (Codegen::expr() in src/lltl/codegen.rs; php::is_php_literal() does not see through chosen branches).

known_mismatch.reason: P35 (plans/parity-fixes.md, G1), part a: PHP gives an array literal the line of its first element (zend_ast_create_list(), PHPSRC/Zend/zend_ast.c) and an element the line of its value (ZEND_AST_ARRAY_ELEM is created as (value, key)). ArrayExpression::compile() (TWIG/src/Node/Expression/ArrayExpression.php) writes a dynamic key's `(string) key =>` before the value, so the debug marker of a name in the key (NameExpression::compile() calls addDebugInfo()) precedes the value and decides the literal's line. zend_try_ct_eval_array() stamps that line on every constant it folds in the literal (zend_eval_const_expr(); zend_ast_create_zval() takes CG(zend_lineno)), here the `null` that ends `($context["e"] ?? null)`, and the `+` emitted after it reports it. php::first_debug_line() (src/lltl/php.rs) only looks at the first element's value, so twig-rs reports the marker in effect before the key.
